notes: A festival stage with an open dance floor in front of it is Entertainment's venue-stage outright, and the Performance Venue preset comes with it - the answers rule out performer roles and timed sets, so this is a hangout venue whose every sightline runs toward the main stage. Kept social-hub as the dance floor and spawn-first-reveal so arrivals land facing the stage, added zone-graphics for the dynamic neon, moving LED screens and laser systems, and vignette-photo for the neon decoration spots around the grounds; the VVIP lounges land on spectator-bleachers, the one option that expresses raised viewing ground, which is what adds tiered to an otherwise plain P0. The answers put everything on one large field with amenities around the perimeter rather than separate walk-between stages, so there is no zone split and no P4. Decided without a user: the lounges are open-sided raised decks and the food trucks are served from their windows, so nothing here is an enterable interior and the build stays off P3; the music channel GUI is UI with no geometry, and the custom dance animations are animation rather than layout.
